According to the data tables and the exchanges between Li Hua and Adam Smith, it is Adam Smith who has volunteered to bring the tools for the curtain installation in the basement. This is confirmed in the conversation entry from June 19th, 2026, where Adam Smith assures Li Hua, "I’ll bring the tools, and we’ll get it done. Looking forward to it!"

In summary, Adam Smith has taken responsibility for providing the necessary tools for the upcoming curtain installation project that Li Hua has requested, demonstrating his readiness and willingness to assist in the physical aspects of completing the task.
